description: 原创评测歌词。尚未生成音频、评分或产生服务费用。每个候选最多尝试三轮，保留所有结果。

cases.title: 晚风来信
cases.lyrics:
[主歌]
把今天折进旧口袋
沿着街灯慢慢走回来
[副歌]
让晚风经过，带走我的沉默
让微亮的灯，照见真实的我

cases.title: 出发之前
cases.lyrics:
[主歌]
车站的钟刚走过七点
你把明天写在我掌心里面
[副歌]
向前一步，再向前一步
让脚下的路，把勇气留住

cases.title: 小小的回声
cases.lyrics:
[主歌]
轻轻地问，轻轻地等
雨落下来，像小小的回声
[副歌]
你听，你听
我把想念，唱给星星

cases.title: 把路走完
cases.lyrics:
[主歌]
那条没有名字的路
还留着昨天的脚步
我把没说完的话
慢慢写成一封信
[副歌]
把路走完，把梦点亮
把远处的灯带回身旁
如果风还记得方向
就让我们继续歌唱
[桥段]
停一下，再出发
天会亮，心会回答

cases.title: Window Light
cases.lyrics:
[Verse]
Fold the day into my coat
Follow lights along the road
[Chorus]
Let the night wind carry me
Past the words I could not speak

cases.title: One More Step
cases.lyrics:
[Verse]
Seven minutes till the train
Sunlight slipping through the rain
[Chorus]
One more step, one more try
Leave a little room for sky

cases.title: Stay Awhile
cases.lyrics:
[Verse]
Wait, wait, let the silence breathe
Stay, stay, there is time to leave
[Chorus]
Here we are, here we stand
Hold the morning in your hands

cases.title: A Road of Our Own
cases.lyrics:
[Verse]
There is a road without a name
It never takes us home the same
I leave a letter by the door
And find a reason to explore
[Chorus]
Walk with me beyond the light
Keep a little hope tonight
Every turn and every stone
Builds a road we call our own
[Bridge]
We can rest and start again
We can learn to trust the rain
